row.notes: F1 World craft inventory: gets items (0x141ac21a0), sorts (0x141b8a8a0, cmp 0x14256c810). Per item card type = byte +0x10 (kind 6) / +0x11 (kind 5) / 0xc upgrade card. Id < 0xf4865700 reuses a slot; else header 0x141ad49d0, created if missing with caption lng_*_slot / lng_*_contract_slot / lng_upgrade_card and icon #overrides.f1_world.craft_header_icons[..]. Card via 0x141ac6480/0x141ac0ad0/0x141ac0f30, count map param+0x1bb; count > 0xd -> lng_crafting_inventory_full (CARD_TYPE = slot name). Then vcall +0xe8. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Career_CraftInventory_PopulateCardList (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V9932 Sets craft_header_icons overrides for all slot types (wing, engine, gearbox, brakes, sponsor, principal, rnd_head, strategist) and lng_*_slot captions, plus lng_crafting_inventory_full; not only rnd_head|sponsor.
